newsitem.title: UK: Chiroscience firms on Medeva deal.
newsitem.headline: Chiroscience firms on Medeva deal.

text.p: Shares in Chiroscience Group Plc firmed after the UK pharmaceutical research and development concern said it agreed with Medeva Plc to continue with the development of a purified version of Medeva's behaviour-controlling drug, Methylphenidate, dealers said
Chiroscience shares were up 4p at 322-1/2p by 0903 GMT, having climbed as high as 330p earlier.
Shares in Medeva, meanwhile, jumped 14p to 293-1/2p nL23253400.
Chiroscience said its Phase I study were successful and that it expects to receive a significant revenue stream from royalties on all worldwide sales.
